direct_obligations.name: Laurent coefficient globalization
direct_obligations.check: Fiberwise coefficients are holomorphic by Cauchy integrals and transform as global sections of B^{-k}.

direct_obligations.name: Negative coefficient vanishing
direct_obligations.check: For k<0, deg(B^{-k})<0; a nonzero section would have a nonnegative-degree zero divisor.

direct_obligations.name: Uniform extension
direct_obligations.check: Cauchy estimates on a fixed fiber circle over a smaller base chart give locally uniform power-series convergence at zero.

direct_obligations.name: Compact circle bundle
direct_obligations.check: The fixed positive-radius norm level is compact over a compact base.

direct_obligations.name: Noncompact holomorphic hull
direct_obligations.check: Every punctured disk point is bounded by the circle maximum for every holomorphic function; a fixed-fiber sequence tending to zero cannot converge in the punctured space.

direct_obligations.name: Dual inversion
direct_obligations.check: The unique covector evaluating to one on a nonzero vector gives a global holomorphic inverse between the punctured dual bundles.

direct_obligations.name: Explicit automorphy cocycle
direct_obligations.check: The composition defect is exp(-2 pi i m s)=1 for lattice integers m,s.

direct_obligations.name: Invariant norm and positive degree
direct_obligations.check: The Gaussian metric is invariant; its Chern form i dz wedge dbar(z)/(2 Im(tau)) has integral one.

direct_obligations.name: Homogeneous invariant
direct_obligations.check: Numerator and denominator of sigma multiply by the same nowhere-zero factor.

direct_obligations.name: Full group action
direct_obligations.check: The b cocycle and sigma invariance give composition and the additive m coefficient; the zero group element is the identity.

direct_obligations.name: Free proper action
direct_obligations.check: Projection to z reduces compact intersections to finitely many lattice translates, and a nonzero lattice translation fixes no point.

direct_obligations.name: Generic full fiber
direct_obligations.check: At a outside {0,-1}, x0 x1 is nonzero and the whole quadric fiber is ty=a with t in C*, not just a dense open part.

direct_obligations.name: Cancellation of affine translation
direct_obligations.check: At a=-K/kappa, the u translation coefficient K+kappa a vanishes exactly.

direct_obligations.name: Closedness of the obstructing slice
direct_obligations.check: The sigma fiber is closed and u descends on it; its zero slice is closed in the ambient quotient.

direct_obligations.name: Ambient hull obstruction
direct_obligations.check: Restrictions of ambient holomorphic functions obey the same circle bounds; the escaping sequence cannot accumulate outside its closed slice.

direct_obligations.name: Exceptional parameters
direct_obligations.check: For K=0 and K=kappa, the two respective fixed quadric points have sigma=0,-1, and u=0 descends to a compact elliptic curve; no generic C* description is used.

direct_obligations.name: Affine quadric isomorphism
direct_obligations.check: The nonzero rank-one matrix with off-diagonal difference one reconstructs both projective factors; the hypersurface cd=s(s-1) is smooth.

direct_obligations.name: Stein universal cover
direct_obligations.check: The affine smooth quadric is Stein; its locally trivial affine-line projection to P1 has contractible fibers and trivial fundamental group.

direct_obligations.name: Scope and attribution
direct_obligations.check: The explicit quotient and punctured-line results are checked directly; arbitrary canonical-extension identification, finite generation and the all-surfaces conjecture are not adopted.
